Nsis7z NSIS plug-in

The NSIS template uses Nsis7z::Extract for the normal non-ZIP package path. The cached x86-unicode plug-in is nsis7z.dll, FileVersion 19.00.0.0 (based on 7-Zip 19.00); SHA-256 and size are recorded under nsis.unicodePlugins in inventory.json.

The plugin author says it follows the 7-Zip source code license. The project distributes under LGPL terms with additional BSD and unRAR terms for applicable files; see third-party/7zip-LICENSE.txt and the full LGPL text in third-party/LICENSES.chromium.html.

Plugin source download/project page: https://nsis.sourceforge.io/Nsis7z_plug-in
7-Zip 19.00 source archive: https://www.7-zip.org/a/7z1900-src.7z
The author's Nsis7z_19.00.7z contains the plug-in source and build projects, and its x86-Unicode DLL matches both audited v0.1.0 candidates.
Plug-in source and binaries: https://nsis.sourceforge.io/mediawiki/images/6/69/Nsis7z_19.00.7z
The plug-in source, upstream 7-Zip 19.00 source and build instructions are available in the corresponding source ZIP on the GitHub Release. An independent rebuild has not been verified.
